Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api

Klasse BetterNPCs

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.BetterNPCs
public final class BetterNPCs extends Object
Static access to the running BetterNPCsApi.

Convenience over Bukkit's services manager, which is the underlying registration and works just as well: 


 BetterNPCsApi api = BetterNPCs.get();
 Npc shop = api.npcManager().byName("shop").orElseThrow();

The API is available from the moment BetterNPCs enables. A dependent plugin should either declare depend: [BetterNPCs] in its own plugin description, which makes Bukkit load it afterwards, or use isAvailable() rather than assuming.

  • Methodendetails

    • get

      public static BetterNPCsApi get()
      Returns the running API.
      Gibt zurück:
      the API
      Löst aus:
      IllegalStateException - if BetterNPCs is not enabled, which usually means the calling plugin did not declare a dependency on it and was loaded first

    • find

      public static Optional<BetterNPCsApi> find()
      Returns the running API if there is one.
      Gibt zurück:
      the API, or empty if BetterNPCs is not enabled

    • isAvailable

      public static boolean isAvailable()
      Returns whether the API is available.
      Gibt zurück:
      true if get() would succeed

    • register

      @Internal public static void register(BetterNPCsApi api)
      Publishes the API. Called by the BetterNPCs plugin during enable.
      Parameter:
      api - the implementation to publish
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if api is null
      IllegalStateException - if an implementation is already published, which would mean two copies of BetterNPCs are loaded

    • unregister

      @Internal public static void unregister()
      Withdraws the API. Called by the BetterNPCs plugin during disable.

      Deliberately tolerant of being called when nothing is registered: shutdown runs after a failed startup too, and a second exception there would bury the first.
